title: CRDTs: The Hard Parts
summary: Martin Kleppmann surveys current research on CRDTs, the algorithms for merging concurrent edits across offline replicas. He covers the hard parts such as rich text, moves and merge results that are technically correct but poor.
why: Recommended as an excellent first education on CRDTs and their limits.

quote.text: I found this video from him to be an excellent first education on CRDTs
